# Security Policy

silv is experimental software (see the README disclaimer). It is a local log viewer: it reads files
you point at and writes to your terminal. It has no network listeners, no privilege escalation, and
no telemetry.

- Report security issues in the [issue tracker](https://github.com/chamoretto/silv/issues) using the
  bug report template. Expect no fix timeline guarantee.
- The project is largely AI-agent generated and human reviewed; treat any patch as ordinary code and
  inspect it before you run it.
- Verified reports are credited in `CHANGELOG.md` under the `Security` section.
